fail_fact.title: Beware of the stings — there might not be honey in the end!
text: In 2017, an internet personality called\\ "Mia Ash from London" lured dozens of professional men from tech companies, government and other important positions to a trap. In fact, "Mia" was a fake profile created by the Iranian intelligence. Via "Mia", they got access to an unprecedented number of classified documents.
